people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
translations.bsb: Then the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s uncle, king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah.
translations.kjv: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
translations.asv: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachins' father's brother, king is his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
